CustomReportFileTemlate.QueryText:
select COUNT (*) OVER () AS ROW_COUNT, bp.Name, bp.Id, r.[RoleId], rolename, r.description as roledescription, r.systemid, SystemDescription FROM BusinessProcessPersonRoles as br inner join [BusinessProcessPersons] as bp on bp.Id = br.BusinessProcessPersonId inner join saproles r on br.roleid = r.RoleId inner join systems s on s.SystemId = r.SystemId ORDER BY bp.Name, r.systemid, rolename
#Pagining#
CustomReportFileTemlate.ReportName: MS Entra IG - Read All Business Roles
